items.name: Beyond Kata
items.priceText: About 7,500-11,800 THB / night (~$220-350). Around Fri 15 Jan about 14,700 THB (~$435). Many dates sell only 2-night stays.
items.whyStay: Beachfront resort on the sand in the southern part of Kata Beach. Easy, relaxed beach days, and Patong's clubs are about 20-25 minutes away by car.
items.description: Four-star family resort directly on Kata Beach, part of Beyond Hotels & Resorts. Rooms go from Superior to Seaview Suite, and some have direct pool access. Kata is a pretty bay with a relaxed mood and sunset views.
items.nearby: On Kata Beach. Illuzion (Patong) about 20-25 min by car. Nai Harn Beach about 15 min by car. Phuket Old Town about 30 min.
tips: Many dates (8, 11-13 and 15-17 Jan) sell only 2-night stays. 1-night rates showed only for 9, 10 and 14 Jan.
It is a family resort, so expect children.
Some recent reviews say rooms feel dated. Ask for a renovated room.

items.name: Mom Tri's Villa Royale
items.whyStay: Romantic luxury boutique hotel on the headland above Kata Noi, with a private path to the beach. Thai-style suites, sea views and calm nights. A peaceful base between party days.
items.description: Small luxury boutique resort on a headland over Kata Noi Beach, created by the architect Mom Tri. It has 42 suites in 12 types, several with private pools, a saltwater pool in the rocks above the sea and two freshwater pools. Mom Tri's Kitchen serves Thai food with sea views.
items.nearby: Kata Noi Beach a few minutes on foot (private path). Kata Beach about 18 min on foot. Illuzion (Patong) about 20-25 min by car. Nai Harn about 15 min by car.
tips: Prices change a lot by date: about 8,400-8,500 THB on Mon 11 and Tue 12 Jan, but about 22,500 THB on Sat 16 Jan.
There are many stairs on the property. It is hard for people who cannot walk well.

items.name: Sugar Marina Hotel ART Karon Beach
items.whyStay: Fun, art-themed hotel about 4 minutes on foot from Karon Beach, with very good reviews. Cheaper than the Kata resorts, and Patong's clubs are about 15 minutes away by car.
items.description: Art-themed, family-friendly hotel in central Karon, from the local Sugar Marina group. Rooms have art details, and Pool Access rooms open straight onto the pool. Karon has a long, wide beach and is quieter than Patong at night.
items.nearby: Karon Beach about 4 min on foot (300 m). Kata Beach about 5-10 min by car. Illuzion (Patong) about 15 min by car.
tips: Book a Premier Pool Access room to step straight into the pool.
Family-friendly, so expect children by the pool.
The official site had an 'Early Bird 60 Days' deal: 10% off if you book 60 or more days ahead (seen 15 Oct 2026).

items.name: The Nai Harn
items.whyStay: Iconic white resort above Nai Harn Bay, about 7 minutes on foot to Nai Harn Beach. Big sea-view terraces and a rooftop sunset bar, in the calm south of the island.
items.description: Five-star resort on the hillside over Nai Harn Bay. It says it is the island's only Leading Hotels of the World member. Most rooms have big private terraces with sea views (there are also mountain-view rooms). Reflections Rooftop Bar and Hansha, a rooftop sushi bar, are good at sunset.
items.nearby: Nai Harn Beach about 7 min on foot. Kata about 15-20 min by car. Illuzion (Patong) about 35-40 min. Phuket Old Town about 30-35 min.
tips: Book a sea-view room; the big terraces are the reason to stay.
January prices were almost the same on weekdays and weekends (about 11,400-12,200 THB).

items.name: Wyndham Grand Nai Harn Beach Phuket
items.whyStay: Five-star resort with 10 pools and top guest scores (Google 4.9) at a mid-range price. Hotel shuttle or a 17-minute walk to Nai Harn Beach. Great value in the relaxed south.
items.description: Large modern resort with lagoons and gardens near Nai Harn Beach. It has 353 rooms, 10 pools, a spa, a gym, a Kids' Club and five restaurants and bars. Its Google score (4.9 from about 3,900 reviews) is very high. Cheaper than the other five-star picks in this list.
items.nearby: Nai Harn Beach about 17 min on foot (1.3 km) or by hotel shuttle. Illuzion (Patong) about 30-40 min by car. Phuket Old Town about 30 min.
tips: Use the hotel shuttle to Nai Harn Beach.
It has a Kids' Club, so expect families.

items.name: Roost Glamping
items.priceText: Dorm bed about 420-480 THB (~$12-14). Tent for two about 1,000-1,200 THB / night (~$30-35).
items.whyStay: Cheap, social glamping in Rawai with tents, an 8-bed dorm and an infinity pool. 5 minutes by car to Nai Harn Beach. A fun budget base in the laid-back south.
items.description: Budget glamping site in Rawai. Choose a premium tent with AC and private bathroom, a fan tent, a 3-bed shared tent or an 8-bed dorm. There is an infinity pool, chilled-out music in an open-air space, and Tojo's Cafe & Bar (open 8:30-21:30).
items.nearby: Nai Harn Beach 5 min by car (2.6 km) or about 30 min on foot. Illuzion (Patong) about 30-40 min by car. Phuket Old Town about 30 min.
tips: Choose a tent with AC and a private bathroom for more comfort.
The beach is not close on foot. Rent a scooter or use Grab.

items.name: Casa Blanca Boutique Hotel
items.whyStay: Restored Sino-Portuguese shophouse hotel with a pool, in the heart of the Old Town. 4 minutes on foot to Thalang Road. Cheap, charming and close to cafes and street food.
items.description: Boutique hotel in restored Sino-Portuguese buildings at 26 Phuket Road in the Old Town. It has a garden, a coffee shop and a swimming pool. Rooms are Deluxe, Premium Deluxe and Family Suite. Good for culture, local food and the Sunday walking street.
items.nearby: Thalang Road 4 min on foot. Courage bar (underground nights, 16 Bangkok Road) about 20 min on foot (1.4 km). Patong about 30 min by car. Airport about 40 min.
tips: On Sun 10 or Sun 17 Jan, visit the Lard Yai walking street on Thalang Road (about 16:00-22:00).
For underground parties in town (SUB, FAKE PALM), check ra.co. In Dec 2025-Feb 2026 they were at Courage bar on Bangkok Road.

items.name: The Memory at On On Hotel
items.whyStay: Sleep in Phuket Town's first hotel, a 1927 Sino-Portuguese building on Phang Nga Road. History and style, with the Old Town's cafes, food and bars at your door.
items.description: Phuket Town's first hotel, built in 1927 by craftsmen from Penang in Sino-Portuguese style, now restored as The Memory. It is a two-storey landmark on Phang Nga Road in the Old Town. You can walk everywhere in the old quarter.
items.nearby: Thalang Road about 6 min on foot. Courage bar (16 Bangkok Road) about 15 min on foot (1.2 km). Patong about 30 min by car. Airport about 40 min.
tips: On Sun 10 or Sun 17 Jan, the Lard Yai walking street runs on Thalang Road (about 16:00-22:00).
Courage bar hosted SUB and FAKE PALM nights in Dec 2025-Feb 2026. Dates are irregular, so check ra.co and Instagram @courage.phuket.

items.name: Shunli Hotel
items.priceText: About 1,400 THB / night (~$41) on 12 and 14 Jan. Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan showed no online rate.
items.whyStay: Tiny owner-run hotel in the Old Town with a 5.0 Google score from 401 reviews. 10 bright rooms, breakfast included, a few minutes on foot to Thalang Road.
items.description: Small, simple hotel at 56 Krabi Road with 10 bright rooms, free Wi-Fi and a home-cooked breakfast. Guests love the kind owners and the central Old Town location. One guest mentions noise from delivery trucks at 3-5 am.
items.nearby: Thalang Road about 3-5 min on foot. Courage bar (16 Bangkok Road) about 18 min on foot (1.3 km). Patong about 30 min by car.
tips: Few online rates for January. Message the hotel on Facebook.
Light sleepers: ask for a room away from the street.

items.name: Milky Bay Resort
items.whyStay: Beachfront resort on Ban Tai beach with a pool. 5 minutes on foot to Chill Up, and 6-8 minutes by car to Halfmoon and OXA. A comfortable base for a Koh Phangan rave trip.
items.description: Mid-range resort on Ban Tai beach, Koh Phangan, with white Cape Dutch style buildings, garden courtyards, a beachfront pool and a beachfront restaurant. Rooms go from Urban Deluxe to an Oceanfront Pavilion. Ban Tai has several big jungle parties, like OXA and Halfmoon.
items.nearby: Chill Up 5 min on foot (400 m). Halfmoon Festival (Magical Forest) about 6 min by car. OXA about 8 min by car. Thong Sala Pier about 7 min by car.
tips: Koh Phangan is on the other coast of Thailand. From Phuket, take the Lomprayah bus + boat (about 7.5 hours) or fly to Koh Samui and take a ferry.
OXA runs most Fridays (21:00-05:00). Tickets for Fri 8 and Fri 15 Jan 2027 are on sale on Megatix (500 THB).
Taxis wait at the OXA exit until sunrise. Share one to pay less.

items.name: Slumber Party Beach Koh Phangan
items.priceText: Dorm bed from about 580 THB / night (~$17, non-refundable) or about 800 THB (~$24) with a flexible rate (Hostelworld, Jan 2027).
items.whyStay: Beachfront party hostel in Ban Tai with a pool and a beach bar. Cheap beds, beer pong and an easy crowd for going out. 5 minutes by car from Thong Sala Pier.
items.description: Party hostel on Ban Tai beach with dorms, private rooms and tents. It has a pool and a beach bar. Guests praise the beach location and the staff. Recent reviews (Sept 2026) report water cuts, a dirty pool and unclean bathrooms.
items.nearby: On Ban Tai beach. Thong Sala Pier 5 min by car. Chill Up 19 min on foot. Halfmoon about 9 min and OXA about 10 min by car.
tips: Hostelworld says it normally accepts guests aged 18-35 only. Check before you book.
Good if you want a party crowd. Not for quiet nights.
Ask the staff about this week's jungle parties and shared taxis.
